capacity.guidance: Ollama System One accepts at most 64 questions; JSON bodies are limited to 64 KiB without images or 32 MiB with images. This gateway accepts at most 16 MiB. Group questions and reduce shared evidence explicitly; the gateway never partitions or trims requests.
